snippet.title: Woodo | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas. No pressure, just a cozy world that remembers what it felt like to be a child.

Pre-order now on console or wishlist on Steam ahead of the release on September 16.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2572040/Woodo/
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012337
https://www.xbox.com/games/store/woodo/9pgq8f7dj7xp
https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Woodo-3153775.html

Follow Woodo's creators here:
https://twitter.com/YulliaProhorova
https://tr.ee/qFjIkFjQtE
https://www.instagram.com/woodo_game/
https://www.woodo-game.com/

2d art and animation in this trailer by Studio Huckepack: https://studiohuckepack.de/
Music by Don Roberts: https://donrobertsmusic.com/
